title: Fantastic Tour
text: What an excellent tour, our guide was so friendly and very informative,  we loved every minute of it :-) We would highly recommend this company to anyone, good quality bikes and very knowledgeable tour guide - 10 out of 10!  The flamenco show was also brilliant, top quality performers!
author: Paulettecoe_C

title: Experience with friends
text: It was a super fun experience with friends we cycled through the city a different way to visit the city and walk it and our guide Dani super attentive with us very good boy recommended 100 percent and the flamenco show very nice
author: mariajU6376LV

title: Experience to repeat
text: The bike tour was super fun to do, we went to a lot of iconic places in the capital, and our guide explained everything in great detail. The flamenco show we loved, it was very nice to see and hear. I would recommend everything!
author: Roam25741183735
